summary.zh: 手机网页端在浏览器会话失效时会明确提示重新登录，并在同一账号下安全恢复未发送草稿与本地附件；失效后的请求不会被自动重放。
summary.en: On Mobile web, an expired browser session now shows an explicit sign-in prompt and, for the same account, safely restores unsent drafts and local-only attachments. Failed requests are never auto-replayed after re-login.

title.zh: 手机网页会话失效后可安全恢复
title.en: Safe Mobile web recovery after session loss

summary.zh: 前台检测或接口返回认证失效时，手机端会收起已登录界面并提示「会话已结束，请重新登录」。同一服务器/用户/工作台再次登录后，可恢复当前会话选择、未发送草稿，以及仍仅保存在本地的附件；换账号则干净启动。中断的发送不会在登录后自动重试。
summary.en: When a foreground check or API reports authentication loss, Mobile leaves the authenticated shell and asks you to sign in again. Logging back in as the same server/user/studio restores the selected chat, unsent draft, and local-only attachments; a different account starts clean. Interrupted sends are not replayed after login.

sources.title: fix(mobile): recover PWA session loss with same-authority restore
